dct_title_s: Goodland Quadrangle, Minnesota - Itasca County, 1969: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Goodland quadrangle topographic map (N4707.5-W9307.5/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink regarding logging railroad lines in the area south of Pengilly. The hand written notations include information on the following logging camps noted with 'C'.
